rachats.citation: Axa offered $57.60 a share in cash, a premium of 33%, which valued the target at $15.3 billion
Acquired for 423 million with an earn-out potential of up to 55 million, completed April 1, 2025.
Axa took a 51% majority stake for 0.5 billion on November 28, 2025.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
